title: Indonesian
description: Everyday Indonesian: greetings, family, food, numbers, getting around and your day.

units.title: Greetings
units.description: Say hello, introduce yourself and be polite.
tips: Greetings follow the time of day: 'selamat pagi' (morning), 'selamat siang' (midday), 'selamat malam' (evening).

units.title: People and family
units.description: Talk about the people around you.
tips: Verbs never change for 'I', 'you' or 'she', and 'dia' means both he and she.

units.title: Food and drink
tips: 'Nasi' is cooked rice; 'beras' is uncooked rice in the shop.

units.title: Numbers
units.description: Count from one to ten, ask prices and tell the time.
tips: Plurals are optional: 'dua anak' (two children) needs no plural ending.

units.title: Travel and directions
units.description: Find your way around a new city.
tips: 'Di' means at or in: 'di mana' (where), 'di kanan' (on the right).

units.title: Daily routine
units.description: Home, work, school and the time of day.
tips: Repeating a word makes a plural: 'anak' (child), 'anak-anak' (children).
